q1.explanationZh: sensible 形容词“明智的；合情理的”，注意与 sensitive“敏感的”区分。

q2.explanationZh: sensitive 形容词“敏感的”，名词 sensitivity“敏感”。

q3.explanationZh: sentence 名词“句子；判决”，动词“宣判”，be sentenced to death“被判处死刑”。

q4.explanationZh: separate 作形容词“分开的”，作动词“使分开”；注意中间是 a：sep-a-rate。

q5.explanationZh: series“系列”，单复数同形，a series of“一系列的”。

q6.explanationZh: serious 形容词“严重的；严肃的”，副词 seriously。

q7.explanationZh: serve“服务”加 -ant 表示人，servant“仆人”。

q8.explanationZh: serve 动词“为……服务；端上食物”，serve as“充当”。

q9.explanationZh: service 是 serve 的名词形式“服务”。

q10.explanationZh: session 名词“一场；一段时间；会议”，注意拼写 -ssion。

q11.explanationZh: set“放；设置”，过去式和过去分词都是 set，现在分词 setting。

q12.explanationZh: setting 名词“环境；背景”，由 set 双写 t 加 -ing 构成。

q13.explanationZh: settle“定居；解决”，settle down“安顿下来”。

q14.explanationZh: settle 加 -r 表示人，settler“移居者”。

q15.explanationZh: several“几个的”，后接可数名词复数。

q16.explanationZh: severe“严重的；严厉的”，be severe on sb.“对某人严厉”。

q17.explanationZh: sew 动词“缝”，读 /səʊ/，和 so 同音。

q18.explanationZh: sex 名词“性别”，复数 sexes，形容词 sexual。

q19.explanationZh: shade 指“阴凉处”，in the shade“在阴凉处”；shadow 指“影子”。

q20.explanationZh: shadow 名词“影子”，注意与 shade“阴凉处”区分。

q21.explanationZh: shake“摇动；握手”，过去式 shook，过去分词 shaken。

q22.explanationZh: shall 是助动词“将要”，常用于第一人称疑问句表示征求意见。

q23.explanationZh: shallow 形容词“浅的”，反义是 deep。

q24.explanationZh: shame 名词“羞耻；遗憾的事”，It’s a shame that...“……真遗憾”。

q26.explanationZh: shape 名词“形状”，动词“使成形”，in good shape“状况良好”。

q27.explanationZh: share 动词“分享”，名词“一份”，share sth. with sb.“与某人分享某物”。

q29.explanationZh: sharp 形容词“锋利的；急转向的”，动词 sharpen。

q30.explanationZh: 形容词 sharp 加 -en 构成动词 sharpen“削尖；磨快”。

q31.explanationZh: sentence 作动词“宣判”，被动语态 be sentenced to death“被判处死刑”。

q32.explanationZh: separate A from B“把 A 和 B 分开”，介词用 from。

q33.explanationZh: separate into“（把整体）分成……”，介词用 into。

q34.explanationZh: in series“连续地；按顺序排列”，series 单复数同形。

q35.explanationZh: serve as“充当，起……作用”，as 后接名词。

q36.explanationZh: serve for“作……用”，for 后接用途。

q37.explanationZh: at one’s service“听某人吩咐”，service 是名词，前面用所有格。

q38.explanationZh: set ... free“释放”，被释放的人或物放在 set 和 free 之间。

q39.explanationZh: set about“开始，着手”，后接名词或动名词：set about doing sth.。

q40.explanationZh: set up“建立；设立”，如 set up a fund“设立基金”。

q41.explanationZh: set aside“留出；把……置于一旁”，如 set aside time“留出时间”。

q42.explanationZh: set off“出发，启程”，也可表示“着手（做某事）”。

q43.explanationZh: set out“出发；开始”，set out to do sth.“开始做某事”。

q44.explanationZh: to one’s shame“令某人惭愧的是”，类似 to one’s surprise 的结构。

q45.explanationZh: put sb. to shame“使某人感到羞愧；使相形见绌”。

q46.explanationZh: 树的“影子”用 shadow；the trees 有很多棵，所以用复数 shadows。

q47.explanationZh: be sentenced to death“被判处死刑”，被动语态用过去分词 sentenced。

q48.explanationZh: round-the-clock service“24 小时服务”，service 是不可数名词。

q49.explanationZh: 躬身送客人出门的是“仆人”servant，前面有 The，用单数。

q50.explanationZh: be separated from“与……分开”，被动语态用过去分词 separated。

q51.explanationZh: 被批评刺痛，说明他是“敏感的”sensitive，作定语修饰 lad。

q52.explanationZh: volunteer to do 后接动词原形，serve as“充当”。

q53.explanationZh: settle down“安顿下来”，与 returned 并列，用过去式 settled。

q54.explanationZh: agree to do 后接动词原形，set aside“把……置于一旁”。

q55.explanationZh: reasons 是复数，前面用 several“几个的”。

q56.sampleAnswer: You can improve your chances of profit by sensible planning.
references: You can improve your chances of profit by sensible planning.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q56.explanationZh: “合理的”用 sensible 修饰 planning；“通过……”用 by doing/by + 名词。

q57.sampleAnswer: The charity has set up a fund for the victims of the earthquake.
references: The charity has set up a fund for the victims of the earthquake.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q57.explanationZh: “已经设立”用现在完成时 has set up；“地震灾民”可译为 the victims of the earthquake。

q58.sampleAnswer: Social activities serve as a bridge between theory and practice.
references: Social activities serve as a bridge between theory and practice.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “是……的桥梁”用 serve as a bridge；“在理论和实际之间”用 between ... and ...。

q59.sampleAnswer: Informed on the phone that the flight had been cancelled, she set out for the train station immediately.
references: Informed on the phone that the flight had been cancelled, she set out for the train station immediately.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “接到电话说……”用过去分词短语 Informed ... that 作状语；“出发去某地”用 set out for。

q60.sampleAnswer: Don’t be severe on him; he is only a boy.
references: Don’t be severe on him; he is only a boy.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “对某人严厉”用 be severe on sb.；否定祈使句用 Don’t be ...。

q61.sampleAnswer: When his teacher told his parents about his behavior, he felt great shame.
references: When his teacher told his parents about his behavior, he felt great shame.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “感到非常羞愧”用 feel great shame；“当……时”用 when 引导时间状语从句。

q62.sampleAnswer: I keep practising yoga after work because it helps me keep in good shape.
references: I keep practising yoga after work because it helps me keep in good shape.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “坚持做某事”用 keep doing；“保持良好的身材”用 keep in good shape。

q63.sampleAnswer: Although the people attending the meeting come from all walks of life, they share a common opinion on the importance of education.
references: Although the people attending the meeting come from all walks of life, they share a common opinion on the importance of education.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “看法一致”用 share a common opinion；“各行各业”是 all walks of life。

q64.sampleAnswer: Not until she knew about the relevant information in the newspaper did she realize how serious the problem of food waste was.
references: Not until she knew about the relevant information in the newspaper did she realize how serious the problem of food waste was.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “直到……才”用 Not until 放句首，主句部分倒装 did she realize；宾语从句 how serious ... was 用陈述语序。

q65.sampleAnswer: Students will benefit a lot by studying abroad, but they are likely to be faced with a series of challenges that they have never met with before.
references: Students will benefit a lot by studying abroad, but they are likely to be faced with a series of challenges that they have never met with before.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “一系列”用 a series of；“面临”用 be faced with；“前所未有的”用定语从句 that they have never met with before。
